meta.name: zephyr-index
meta.description: Static human-browsable catalog of the Zephyr RTOS skill set. Skill selection is handled by the zephyr-agent-skills entry point and by zephyr-cli skills suggest; this index is a reference listing only, not a task skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 浏览 Zephyr RTOS 技能目录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想查看并选择可用的 Zephyr RTOS 技能。
copy.tagline_en: Browse the Zephyr RTOS skill catalog
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to view and select available Zephyr RTOS skills.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成一个 Zephyr RTOS 技能目录，帮你浏览和选择适用的开发技能，但不直接执行任务。
howto.when: 当你开始新的 Zephyr 任务但不确定用哪个技能，或想了解技能总览时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看 Zephyr 技能目录。
say.note: 会显示全部 21 个技能分类。

say.text: 根据任务描述推荐一个技能。
say.note: 会引导你使用决策树或快速参考。
会展示任务到技能的映射表。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude acts as a Zephyr RTOS skill catalog, helping you browse and select relevant development skills, but does not execute tasks directly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you start a new Zephyr task and need help choosing a skill, or when you want an overview of the skill set.

say_en.text: Show me the Zephyr skill catalog.
say_en.note: Lists all 21 consolidated skills by category.

say_en.text: Recommend a skill for my task.
say_en.note: Guides you through the decision tree or quick reference.
